newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Onpa Plc - Seamico.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Onpa Plc - Seamico.

text.p: Seamico Securities Plc said on Tuesday it put a buy recommendation on Thai audio and video distributor and manufacturer Onpa Plc.
Seamico said it has revised its earlier 1996 profit forecast for the firm up 35 percent to 405 million baht ($16.2 million) from 300 million baht.

Seamico said moving its production facilities to Rayong province from provinces closer to Bangkok will save Onpa 35 percent in tax in the second half of this year due to privileges granted by the Board of Investment.
Seamico said Onpa will see margins increase as sales of pre-recorded music tape cassettes account for a higher proportion of net sales this year. Margins on cassettes are 23-31 percent.
Onpa makes tapes and compact discs for clients which include media companies EMI, Sony, Polygram, BMG and WEA. ($1 = 25 baht)
